newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet says gets Atlas majority.
newsitem.headline: Valmet says gets Atlas majority.

text.p: Finnish paper machine engineering group said in a statement on Thursday that a majority of Atlas Converting Equipment's owners had accepted its 700 million markka bid for the whole company.
"So far, Valmet either owns or has received a commitment to ... a total of 82 percent of the share capital," it said, adding it had extended the period of its bid to July 16.
The 82 percent included 15 percent acquired from the market during the offer period and Atlas directors' undertaking to sell a total of 26 percent of capital.

Valmet said on June 4 the acquisition of Atlas -- a manufacturer of reels, vacuum metalliser machines and sheet cutters -- would enable it to market a full range of products to the global flexible packaging industry.
